title: Meet Dean Roy, the 15-Year-Old Running for Vermont Governor and Ready for ‘Impact’
summary: Dean Roy, 15, will appear on the ballot in November as a third-party candidate. He said his generation’s concerns, like affordability and climate change, have been ignored for too long.
